hero_description: Uzm. Dr. Elvin Hasanli spent five years training in neurology at Ege University Hospital in Izmir. He now sees patients in Baku for headaches, seizures, MS, stroke, movement disorders and memory problems.
board_badge_description: Passed the Turkish Neurology Board exam
about_description_part1: Uzm. Dr. Hasanli graduated from Azerbaijan Medical University in 2017 and did his neurology residency at Ege University Faculty of Medicine Hospital in Izmir. Over those five years he worked as a resident and research assistant, from the neuro ICU to the outpatient clinics.
about_description_part2: He got his Turkish Neurology Board certificate in 2025 and is now back in Baku. He'll take the time to explain what's going on and what your options are, in words that make sense.
why_us_item1: Trained at a university hospital in Izmir
neurology_specialties_page_description: The conditions Uzm. Dr. Hasanli sees most often, and what he can do for each one.
headache_migraine_desc: Migraine, tension-type headache and cluster headache. Nerve blocks when tablets aren't enough.
headache_migraine_desc_full: Most headaches are migraine or tension-type, but some need a closer look. The first step is working out which type you have and ruling out anything more serious. Then comes a plan for the attacks themselves and, if they're frequent, something to prevent them. For cluster headache and hard-to-treat migraine, occipital (GON) and sphenopalatine nerve blocks are an option.
epilepsy_seizures_desc: Finding out what the episodes are, reading the EEG, and getting seizures under control.
epilepsy_seizures_desc_full: Not every blackout or jerk is epilepsy, so the diagnosis has to be right before treatment starts. Uzm. Dr. Hasanli uses the history, the exam and the EEG to sort this out, then picks a medication that controls the seizures with as few side effects as possible.
multiple_sclerosis_desc: Multiple sclerosis, NMOSD and related conditions, including the effect MS can have on thinking.
multiple_sclerosis_desc_full: Multiple sclerosis, neuromyelitis optica spectrum disorder and other demyelinating diseases need long-term follow-up. That means choosing the right disease-modifying treatment, keeping an eye on MRI scans and dealing with relapses quickly. Uzm. Dr. Hasanli wrote the chapter on MS and cognition for a Turkish textbook on cognitive disorders, so memory and concentration get attention too.
parkinsons_disease_desc: Parkinson's disease, tremor and other movement problems, with treatment adjusted as things change.
parkinsons_disease_desc_full: Parkinson's disease, essential tremor and other movement disorders change over the years, and so does the treatment. Regular check-ups help keep symptoms under control and catch side effects early.
stroke_neurology_desc: Ischemic and hemorrhagic stroke: finding the cause and lowering the risk of another one.
stroke_neurology_desc_full: After a stroke or TIA, the most important questions are why it happened and how to stop it happening again. Uzm. Dr. Hasanli looks at the scans and tests, adjusts blood thinners and other medication, and stays involved during recovery.
memory_disorders_desc: Memory complaints, Alzheimer's disease and frontotemporal dementia. Testing, treatment and family support.
memory_disorders_desc_full: Forgetfulness has many causes, and some of them are treatable. Cognitive testing and a look at blood tests and imaging help separate normal ageing from Alzheimer's disease, frontotemporal dementia and other conditions. Families are part of the conversation from the start.
neuromuscular_desc: Myasthenia gravis, polyneuropathy and other nerve and muscle problems, checked with EMG.
neuromuscular_desc_full: Numbness, tingling, weakness and drooping eyelids can come from the nerves, the muscles or the junction between them. Nerve conduction studies and EMG, including single-fibre and repetitive stimulation tests, show where the problem is so treatment can be aimed properly.
neuro_ophthalmology_desc: Raised or low brain pressure, double vision and vertigo, checked with fundus exam, OCT and evoked potentials.
neuro_ophthalmology_desc_full: Some problems sit between neurology, ophthalmology and ENT: idiopathic intracranial hypertension, intracranial hypotension, double vision (ophthalmoplegia) and vertigo. Uzm. Dr. Hasanli uses fundus examination, OCT, visual and sensory evoked potentials and audiometry to work out what's behind the symptoms.
sleep_disorders_desc: Long-standing insomnia and narcolepsy, looked at properly before reaching for sleeping pills.
sleep_disorders_desc_full: Poor sleep wears everything else down. For chronic insomnia and narcolepsy, the first job is understanding the pattern and what's driving it. Treatment follows from that, with medication used where it actually helps.

bio_heading: From Baku to Izmir and back
bio_paragraph1: Elvin Hasanli studied medicine at Azerbaijan Medical University from 2011 to 2017. In December 2020 he started his neurology residency at Ege University Faculty of Medicine Hospital in Izmir, where he also worked as a research assistant until December 2025. The work covered a lot of ground: the neuro ICU, stroke, epilepsy, MS, nerve and muscle disease, headache and dementia, with EEG, EMG and lumbar punctures as part of the daily routine.
bio_paragraph2: In 2025 he passed the 21st Turkish Neurology Board exam. He also wrote the chapter on multiple sclerosis and cognition for a Turkish textbook on cognitive disorders, and has kept up with the field at national meetings on neurology, epilepsy, stroke and neuromuscular disease. He now practises as a neurologist in Baku.

diagnostic_treatment_services_descriptio: What can be done during or after your visit.
neurological_consultation_desc: A proper first visit: your history, a full neurological exam and a clear plan for what comes next. Follow-up visits too.
eeg_testing_desc: Records the brain's electrical activity. Used for epilepsy, unexplained blackouts and some causes of confusion.
emg_ncs_desc: Nerve conduction, needle EMG, single-fibre EMG, repetitive stimulation and blink reflex. Used for neuropathy, carpal tunnel, pinched nerves and myasthenia.
evoked_potentials_desc: VEP, SEP, fundus examination and OCT. Useful in MS, optic nerve problems and raised pressure inside the head.
nerve_block_injections_desc: Greater occipital nerve (GON) and sphenopalatine blocks for migraine and cluster headache that don't settle with tablets.
lumbar_puncture_desc: A small sample of spinal fluid to check for infection, inflammation such as MS, or bleeding. Also used to measure and lower pressure in IIH.
cognitive_assessment_desc: Standard tests such as MoCA and MMSE to pick up memory problems early and follow them over time.
second_opinion_desc: Already have a diagnosis but want someone else to look? Bring your scans, test results and letters.
not_sure_service_needed_description: Book a regular consultation. Uzm. Dr. Hasanli will tell you which tests are worth doing, if any.
